# Leaflet 1.9.4

Vendored from `https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/` on 16 November 2026. The upstream BSD-2-Clause licence is in `LICENSE`. Browser files are pinned and served locally; the landing page does not depend on a JavaScript CDN at runtime.

Documentation: https://leafletjs.com/reference-1.9.4.html

The library is unmodified. Raster marker images are bundled for distribution completeness; the CivicTrack map controls use SVG vectors and no emoji icons.
